# Exhibitor Prospectus. Join City Leaders From across the Country in

 September 1, 2016 | Author: Lucy Harmon | Category: N/A 

#### Short Description

 Download Exhibitor Prospectus. Join City Leaders From across the Country in... 

#### Description

 Exhibitor Prospectus 2015 NATIONAL LEAGUE OF CITIES CONGRESS OF CITIES Join City Leaders From across the Country in Music City Center • Nashville, Tennessee Exposition Dates: November 4-6, 2015 Conference Dates: November 4-7, 2015 Connecting City Leaders & Solution Providers The municipal government market is large… $1.6 trillion large. The National League of Cities Congress of Cities and Exposition is your opportunity to meet the mayors, city council members, commissioners, city managers, administrators & department heads who make municipal spending decisions on solutions that help them better manage their cities. NLC Members and Conference Attendees are Solution Seekers 2014 Congress of Cities and Exposition at-a-Glance The National League of Cities conference will attract more than 3,000 municipal leaders from 49 states interested in solutions ranging from after-school activities to civic engagement to municipal finance to public safety to waste management. NLC member cities are small towns of less than 1,000 residents to large cities with a population of more than 1,000,000 people. NLC’s exhibitors understand the value of reaching this important audience. The number of exhibitors in 2014 grew 24% over 2013! The National League of Cities conference was recognized in a Trade Show Executive as one of the top 50 fastest growing shows. Don’t miss your opportunity to be among the growing number of suppliers promoting solutions cities use everyday. If you offer products or services in the following areas, you’ll want to be there: • Economic Development • Infrastructure and Construction • Healthcare • Family Welfare • Parks and Recreation • Education • Technology • Public Safety • Sustainability • Housing • Violence Prevention • Transportation and Parking 2014 City Size Represented More than 500,000 n 10% 200,000-500,000 n 10% 33% 50,000-200,000 n 30,000-50,000 n 32% Under 30,000 n 15% 2014 Attendee Role in Government Council Member n Mayor n City Manager/Administrator n State Local Government Employee n Other n 52% 19% 16% 10% 3% Be Seen in Nashville. Enjoy the Nashville Scene. Why Nashville? It’s the place attendees want to experience and exhibitors want to be! • Recently named by Fodor’s Travel, Condé Nast Traveler & The New York Times as one of the top cities to visit • 50% of U.S. population within a 600 mile radius • A diverse, inclusive and fascinating city that appeals to all ages… and musical interests • Record-breaking attendance destination for meetings & conventions (Nashville Convention and Visitors Corp.) • Easily accessible by air or interstate highway Exhibitor Benefits • Pre-show visibility on NLC’s main conference website, including a link to a searchable listing of all exhibitors • Pre-show notice directing attendees to the list of exhibitors on the main conference website • Access to conference attendees through exclusive exhibit floor time, including a Welcome Reception and two conference-wide luncheons Standard Booth Package • 4 exhibitor badges per 10’ x 10’ booth space • Post-conference attendee roster • 8’ back drape and 3’ side drape • Identification sign for inline booths Exhibit Space Rates (per 10’ X 10’ booth) • Associate Member $2,400 • Non-Member $2,600 • Corporate Partner $2,200 • U.S. Communities Partner $2,200 • Non-Profit $1,900 (first 10’ x 10’ booth only) For more information: www.NLCCongressOfCities.org Increase Your Brand Visibility with an NLC Sponsorship Sponsorship Opportunities Sponsoring during the four days of networking and learning will provide excellent brand visibility and demonstrate your company’s commitment to the nation’s cities and towns. Invest in one of the many conference sponsorship opportunities to: • Reinforce your company’s name and create brand awareness with the nation’s top local government decision makers • Build credibility for products and services within a group of highly networked elected and career officials • Enhance your corporate image by sponsoring a nationally-recognized and respected organization For more information about sponsorship and advertising opportunities, contact David Maloney at 202-626-3174 or [email protected] 2014 Exhibitors 2FA Inc Accela, Inc Accessology ActiveBidder Advance Auto Parts Adventos LLC Aetna Alternative Claims Management America in Bloom American City & County American Fidelity American Nonsmoker’s Rights Foundation American Ramp Company American Traffic Solutions, Inc.
